// HVACGAS - gas heating and piping calculator for HVACR classes, for the
// HP Prime (G1 or G2), written in HP PPL.
//
// Set up for Arkansas: gas piping follows the 2018 Arkansas Fuel Gas Code
// (the 2018 IFGC with state amendments).
//
// The home screen has twenty tiles: gas pipe sizing from the eight
// Arkansas Table 402.4 capacity tables (natural gas: steel, copper and PE)
// plus the IFGC propane tables as a reference, pipe capacity, fitting allowance, gas load, clocking the
// meter, manifold pressure, altitude derate, combustion air, flue gas
// analysis, furnace output, oil nozzles, gas pressure tests, fuel cost,
// a unit converter, copper tube and steel pipe data, pipe offsets,
// expansion and brazing alloys, and Learn (short reference pages).
//
// A tool shows its input boxes at the top and its results below; the
// results update as soon as a value changes.  Tap a box to type a value (or
// pick from a list), or select it with Left/Right and type the number on
// the keypad.
//
// The TABLES block (tools, input boxes and every code and handbook table)
// is generated by tools/gen_gas_tables.py.

// units of the unit converter, by kind (pressure, energy, heat rate)
convUnits(k)
BEGIN
  IF k==1 THEN RETURN {"in w.c.","psi","oz/in²","in Hg","kPa","mbar","ft w.c."}; END;
  IF k==2 THEN RETURN {"Btu","therm","kWh","ft³ nat. gas","ccf nat. gas","LP gallon","LP pound","oil gallon"}; END;
  RETURN {"Btu/h","MBH","kW","tons","hp","CFH nat. gas","LP gal/h"};
END;

// capacity table n
pipeTab(n)
BEGIN
  IF n==1 THEN RETURN gP1; END;
  IF n==2 THEN RETURN gP2; END;
  IF n==3 THEN RETURN gP3; END;
  IF n==4 THEN RETURN gP4; END;
  IF n==5 THEN RETURN gP5; END;
  IF n==6 THEN RETURN gP6; END;
  IF n==7 THEN RETURN gP7; END;
  IF n==8 THEN RETURN gP8; END;
  IF n==9 THEN RETURN gP9; END;
  IF n==10 THEN RETURN gP10; END;
  IF n==11 THEN RETURN gP11; END;
  IF n==12 THEN RETURN gP12; END;
  IF n==13 THEN RETURN gP13; END;
  IF n==14 THEN RETURN gP14; END;
  IF n==15 THEN RETURN gP15; END;
  IF n==16 THEN RETURN gP16; END;
  IF n==17 THEN RETURN gP17; END;
  IF n==18 THEN RETURN gP18; END;
  RETURN gP1;
END;

// size names and inside diameters of size set s
sizeSet(s)
BEGIN
  IF s==1 THEN RETURN {"1/2 in","3/4 in","1 in","1-1/4 in","1-1/2 in","2 in","2-1/2 in","3 in","4 in","5 in","6 in","8 in","10 in","12 in"}; END;
  IF s==2 THEN RETURN {"1/2 in","3/4 in","1 in","1-1/4 in","1-1/2 in","2 in","2-1/2 in","3 in","4 in"}; END;
  IF s==3 THEN RETURN {"1/4 (3/8 OD)","3/8 (1/2 OD)","1/2 (5/8 OD)","5/8 (3/4 OD)","3/4 (7/8 OD)","1 (1-1/8 OD)","1-1/4 (1-3/8 OD)","1-1/2 (1-5/8 OD)","2 (2-1/8 OD)"}; END;
  IF s==4 THEN RETURN {"1/2 SDR 9","3/4 SDR 11","1 SDR 11","1-1/4 SDR 10","1-1/2 SDR 11","2 SDR 11"}; END;
  IF s==5 THEN RETURN {"1/2 SDR 9","3/4 SDR 11","1 SDR 11","1-1/4 SDR 10","1-1/2 SDR 11","2 SDR 11","3 SDR 11","4 SDR 11"}; END;
  IF s==6 THEN RETURN {"1/2 SDR 7","1 SDR 11"}; END;
  RETURN {};
END;

  IF s==1 THEN RETURN {0.622,0.824,1.049,1.38,1.61,2.067,2.469,3.068,4.026,5.047,6.065,7.981,10.02,11.938}; END;

  RETURN {};
END;

// table lengths (ft) of length set s
lenSet(s)

  RETURN {};
END;

// fixed choice lists (9 = the converter's units)

BEGIN
  IF c==1 THEN RETURN {"AR 2 stl 0.5wc","AR 5 stl 2-1","AR 7 stl 5-3.5","AR 9 Cu 0.5wc","AR 12 Cu 2-1","AR 14 Cu 5-3.5","AR 21 PE 0.5wc","AR 22 PE 2-1","LP 28 stl 0.5wc","LP 30 Cu 0.5wc","LP 35 PE 0.5wc","LP 37 PEt 0.5wc","LP 25 stl 10-1","LP 26 stl 10-3","LP 27 stl 2-1","LP 29 Cu 10-1","LP 31 Cu 2-1","LP 36 PE 2-1"}; END;
  IF c==2 THEN RETURN {"CFH","kBtu/h","Btu/h"}; END;
  IF c==3 THEN RETURN {"Natural gas","Propane (LP)"}; END;
  IF c==4 THEN RETURN {"1/8 in","1/4 in","3/8 in","1/2 in","3/4 in","1 in","1-1/4 in","1-1/2 in","2 in","2-1/2 in","3 in","4 in","5 in","6 in","8 in","10 in","12 in"}; END;
  IF c==5 THEN RETURN {"No","Yes"}; END;
  IF c==6 THEN RETURN {"None (open)","Metal 75%","Wood 25%"}; END;
  IF c==7 THEN RETURN {"Natural gas","Propane","#2 fuel oil"}; END;
  IF c==8 THEN RETURN {"Pressure","Energy","Heat rate"}; END;
  IF c==10 THEN RETURN {"Type K","Type L","Type M","ACR soft","ACR hard"}; END;
  IF c==11 THEN RETURN {"1/4 nominal","3/8 nominal","1/2 nominal","5/8 nominal","3/4 nominal","1 nominal","1-1/4 nominal","1-1/2 nominal","2 nominal","2-1/2 nominal","3 nominal","3-1/2 nominal","4 nominal","5 nominal","6 nominal","8 nominal","10 nominal","12 nominal"}; END;
  IF c==12 THEN RETURN {"1/8 OD","3/16 OD","1/4 OD","5/16 OD","3/8 OD","1/2 OD","5/8 OD","3/4 OD","7/8 OD","1-1/8 OD","1-3/8 OD","1-5/8 OD","2-1/8 OD","2-5/8 OD","3-1/8 OD","3-5/8 OD","4-1/8 OD"}; END;
  IF c==13 THEN RETURN {"11-1/4°","22-1/2°","30°","45°","60°"}; END;
  IF c==14 THEN RETURN {"Copper","Carbon steel","PVC","CPVC","Aluminum","Custom"}; END;
  IF c==15 THEN RETURN {"BCuP-2","BCuP-3","BCuP-4","BCuP-5","BCuP-6","BCuP-7","BCuP-8","BCuP-9","BAg-5","BAg-6","BAg-7","BAg-20","BAg-28","BAg-34","Solder 50-50","Solder 95-5"}; END;
  RETURN convUnits(gV(70));
END;

// ---- state (program variables keep their values between runs) ----
gScr:=1;        // screen: 1 tiles, 2 a tool
gHome:=1;       // highlighted tile (20 = Learn)

gEnt:=0;        // 1 while a number is typed into the selected box
gEK:={};        // keys typed so far: 0-9, 10 = decimal point
gENeg:=0;       // the typed number is negative
gDown:=0;       // a finger went down on this screen (taps without it are left
                // over from a dialog and are ignored)
gRL:={};        // result rows of the current tool: label, value, note, colour
gRV:={};
gRN:={};
gRC:={};

// ================= number formatting =================

// whole number as text, independent of the calculator's number format
istr(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n:=ROUND(ABS(v),0);
  LOCAL s:="";
  IF n<1 THEN RETURN "0"; END;
  WHILE n>=1 DO
    s:=CHAR(48+(n MOD 10))+s;
    n:=IP(n/10);
  END;
  IF v<0 THEN s:="-"+s; END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// one decimal place
fmt1(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n:=ROUND(ABS(v)*10,0);
  LOCAL s:=istr(IP(n/10))+"."+CHAR(48+(n MOD 10));
  IF v<0 AND n>0 THEN s:="-"+s; END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// v with d decimal places (d = 0 to 5)
fmtN(v,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL m:=10^d;
  LOCAL n:=ROUND(ABS(v)*m,0);
  LOCAL s:=istr(IP(n/m));
  LOCAL f;
  IF d>0 THEN
    f:=istr(n MOD m);
    WHILE DIM(f)<d DO f:="0"+f; END;
    s:=s+"."+f;
  END;
  IF v<0 AND n>0 THEN s:="-"+s; END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// up to d decimals, trailing zeros dropped
fmtTr(v,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL s:=fmtN(v,d);
  IF d>0 THEN
    WHILE RIGHT(s,1)=="0" DO s:=LEFT(s,DIM(s)-1); END;
    IF RIGHT(s,1)=="." THEN s:=LEFT(s,DIM(s)-1); END;
  END;
  RETURN s;
END;

// any size of number; very large or small ones as 1.23E-6
fmtE(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL a:=ABS(v);
  LOCAL ex, m;
  IF a<0.000000000001 THEN RETURN "0"; END;
  IF a>=0.001 AND a<10000000 THEN
    // six significant figures
    ex:=5;
    IF a>=10 THEN ex:=4; END;
    IF a>=100 THEN ex:=3; END;
    IF a>=1000 THEN ex:=2; END;
    IF a>=10000 THEN ex:=1; END;
    IF a>=100000 THEN ex:=0; END;
    RETURN fmtTr(v,ex);
  END;
  ex:=FLOOR(LN(a)/LN(10));
  m:=a/10^ex;
  IF m>=9.9995 THEN
    m:=m/10;
    ex:=ex+1;
  END;
  IF m<1 THEN
    m:=m*10;
    ex:=ex-1;
  END;
  RETURN IFTE(v<0,"-","")+fmtTr(m,3)+"E"+istr(ex);
END;

// ================= gas look-ups =================

sqroot(x)
BEGIN
  RETURN MAX(0,x)^0.5;
END;

// heating value: the box's value, or 1,000 (natural gas, the code's
// example) / 2,516 Btu per cubic foot (propane) when it is 0
hvOf(v,g)
BEGIN
  IF v>0 THEN RETURN v; END;
  RETURN IFTE(g==2,2516,1000);
END;

// row of table t for a length: the first table length equal to or longer
// than lf (0 = longer than the table)
lenRow(t,lf)
BEGIN
  LOCAL ls:=lenSet(gTLn(t));
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(ls) DO
    IF ls(k)>=lf-0.0001 THEN RETURN k; END;
  END;
  RETURN 0;
END;

// Table A102.4 capacity multiplier for natural gas of specific gravity sg
// (the next higher gravity listed)
sgMul(sg)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gSG) DO
    IF gSG(k)>=sg-0.0001 THEN RETURN gSGm(k); END;
  END;
  RETURN gSGm(SIZE(gSG));
END;

unitName(t)
BEGIN
  RETURN IFTE(gTUnit(t)==1,"CFH","kBtu/h");
END;

// whole number with thousands commas, e.g. 100,000
ithou(v)
BEGIN
  LOCAL s:=istr(ABS(v));
  LOCAL o:="";
  WHILE DIM(s)>3 DO
    o:=","+RIGHT(s,3)+o;
    s:=LEFT(s,DIM(s)-3);
  END;
  RETURN IFTE(v<0 AND ROUND(ABS(v),0)>0,"-","")+s+o;
END;

capTxt(v)
BEGIN
  IF v<=0 THEN RETURN "NA"; END;
  RETURN ithou(v);
END;

// inches to the nearest 1/16, e.g. 16-15/16 in
fmtIn(x)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n:=ROUND(ABS(x)*16,0);
  LOCAL w:=IP(n/16);
  LOCAL f:=n MOD 16;
  LOCAL d:=16;
  LOCAL s;
  WHILE f>0 AND (f MOD 2)==0 DO
    f:=f/2;
    d:=d/2;
  END;
  s:=istr(w);
  IF f>0 THEN
    IF w>0 THEN s:=s+"-"+istr(f)+"/"+istr(d); ELSE s:=istr(f)+"/"+istr(d); END;
  END;
  RETURN IFTE(x<0,"-","")+s+" in";
END;

// Table 415.1 support spacing for smooth-wall tubing of outside diameter od
tubeSup(od)
BEGIN
  IF od<0.49 THEN RETURN "not listed under 1/2 OD"; END;
  IF od<0.51 THEN RETURN "every 4 ft"; END;
  IF od<0.76 THEN RETURN "every 6 ft"; END;
  IF od<1.01 THEN RETURN "every 8 ft"; END;
  RETURN "vertical: every floor";
END;

// ================= drawing helpers (all draw into G1) =================

textw(s,fnt)
BEGIN
  LOCAL w:=TEXTOUT_P(s,G9,0,0,fnt);
  IF w<=0 THEN w:=DIM(s)*(4+fnt); END;
  RETURN w;
END;

// text centred on x, top edge at y
ctext(s,x,y,fnt,c)
BEGIN
  TEXTOUT_P(s,G1,x-textw(s,fnt)/2,y,fnt,c);
END;

// text right aligned to x, top edge at y
rtext(s,x,y,fnt,c)
BEGIN
  TEXTOUT_P(s,G1,x-textw(s,fnt),y,fnt,c);
END;

// 2-pixel outline
box2(x1,y1,x2,y2,c)
BEGIN
  RECT_P(G1,x1,y1,x2,y1+1,c);
  RECT_P(G1,x1,y2-1,x2,y2,c);
  RECT_P(G1,x1,y1,x1+1,y2,c);
  RECT_P(G1,x2-1,y1,x2,y2,c);
END;

// small button in the title bar
chip(s,x)
BEGIN
  RECT_P(G1,x,2,x+44,18,cEdge,cBtn);
  ctext(s,x+22,5,1,cText);
END;

// row of five touch buttons along the bottom of the screen
drawMenu(lst)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO 5 DO
    RECT_P(G1,(k-1)*64,220,k*64-2,239,cEdge,cBtn);
    ctext(lst(k),(k-1)*64+31,225,1,cText);
  END;
END;

// ================= input boxes =================

// the conduit trade size box is only used when finding wires that fit
slotName(s)
BEGIN
  RETURN gSL(s);
END;

slotUnit(s)
BEGIN
  RETURN gSU(s);
END;

// text shown in an input box
slotText(s)
BEGIN
  LOCAL u:=slotUnit(s);
  LOCAL v:=gV(s);
  LOCAL lst, t;
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN
    lst:=choiceList(gSC(s));
    RETURN lst(MAX(1,MIN(SIZE(lst),v)));
  END;
  IF v==0 AND gSZ(s)==1 THEN RETURN "--"; END;
  IF v==0 AND gSZ(s)==2 THEN RETURN "?"; END;
  IF v==0 AND gSZ(s)==3 THEN RETURN "auto"; END;
  IF gSD(s)<0 THEN t:=fmtTr(v,4); ELSE t:=fmtN(v,gSD(s)); END;
  IF u=="" THEN RETURN t; END;
  IF LEFT(u,1)=="°" THEN RETURN t+u; END;
  RETURN t+" "+u;
END;

setSlot(s,v)
BEGIN
  gV(s):=MAX(gSLo(s),MIN(gSHi(s),v));
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN gV(s):=ROUND(gV(s),0); END;
  // a new kind of unit starts the converter at its first unit
  IF s==70 THEN gV(72):=1; END;
END;

// Up/Down: step a number, or move through a choice list
bumpSlot(s,d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL n;
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN
    n:=SIZE(choiceList(gSC(s)));
    gV(s):=gV(s)+IFTE(d>0,1,-1);
    IF gV(s)>n THEN gV(s):=1; END;
    IF gV(s)<1 THEN gV(s):=n; END;
    IF s==70 THEN gV(72):=1; END;
  ELSE
    setSlot(s,gV(s)+d*gSS(s));
  END;
END;

// a two-way choice flips, a longer list opens, a number opens a dialog
editSlot(s)
BEGIN
  LOCAL v:=gV(s);
  LOCAL lst;
  IF gSC(s)>0 THEN
    lst:=choiceList(gSC(s));
    IF SIZE(lst)==2 THEN
      setSlot(s,IFTE(v==1,2,1));
    ELSE
      IF CHOOSE(v,slotName(s),lst) THEN
        IF v>=1 THEN setSlot(s,v); END;
      END;
    END;
  ELSE
    IF INPUT(v,slotName(s),slotName(s)+":",gSH(s)) THEN
      IF TYPE(v)==0 THEN setSlot(s,v); END;
    END;
  END;
  gDown:=0;
END;

// ---- typing a number straight into the selected box ----

// key code -> digit 0-9, 10 for the decimal point, -1 for other keys
keyDigit(ev)
BEGIN
  LOCAL kc:={47,42,43,44,37,38,39,32,33,34,48};
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO 11 DO
    IF ev==kc(k) THEN RETURN k-1; END;
  END;
  RETURN -1;
END;

entText()
BEGIN
  LOCAL s:=IFTE(gENeg,"-","");
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK) DO
    s:=s+IFTE(gEK(k)==10,".",CHAR(48+gEK(k)));
  END;
  RETURN s;
END;

entVal()
BEGIN
  LOCAL v:=0;
  LOCAL sc:=0;
  LOCAL k, d;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK) DO
    d:=gEK(k);
    IF d==10 THEN
      sc:=1;
    ELSE
      IF sc>0 THEN
        sc:=sc/10;
        v:=v+d*sc;
      ELSE
        v:=v*10+d;
      END;
    END;
  END;
  RETURN IFTE(gENeg,-v,v);
END;

typeKey(d)
BEGIN
  LOCAL hasdot:=0;
  LOCAL k;
  IF gEnt==0 THEN
    gEnt:=1;
    gEK:={};
    gENeg:=0;
  END;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK) DO
    IF gEK(k)==10 THEN hasdot:=1; END;
  END;
  IF (d<10 OR hasdot==0) AND SIZE(gEK)<12 THEN gEK(SIZE(gEK)+1):=d; END;
END;

backKey()
BEGIN
  LOCAL nl:={};
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gEK)-1 DO
    nl(k):=gEK(k);
  END;
  gEK:=nl;
  IF SIZE(gEK)==0 THEN gEnt:=0; END;
END;

// store the typed number (if any) in the selected box
commitEnt()
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  IF gEnt AND SIZE(gEK)>0 THEN setSlot(sl(gTSel),entVal()); END;
  gEnt:=0;
END;

// ================= help =================

// full-screen page of text; lines that start with a space are body text
showText(ttl,t)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k, ev;
  LOCAL done:=0;
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,239,cBg);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,20,cPanel);
  TEXTOUT_P(ttl,G1,5,4,2,cText);
  rtext("tap or press a key",314,6,1,cDim);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(t) DO
    TEXTOUT_P(t(k),G1,6,10+k*14,1,IFTE(LEFT(t(k),1)==" ",cText,cSelc));
  END;
  BLIT_P(G0,G1);
  REPEAT
    ev:=WAIT(-1);
    IF TYPE(ev)==6 THEN
      IF ev(1)==3 THEN done:=1; END;
    ELSE
      IF ev>=0 THEN done:=1; END;
    END;
  UNTIL done;
  gDown:=0;
END;

showHelp()
BEGIN
  showText("HVAC GAS",{
    "TILES",
    " Tap a tile (or use the arrows and Enter).",
    " Learn: short code and trade notes.  Esc: quit.",
    "INSIDE A TOOL",
    " Tap a box to type a number or pick a choice.",
    " Or select a box with Left/Right and just type",
    " the number on the keypad, then press Enter.",
    " Up/Down: step the value.  Del: erase a digit.",
    " RESET puts that tool's example values back.",
    " HELP shows the rule the tool uses.",
    "TABLES",
    " 2018 Arkansas Fuel Gas Code: Tables 402.4(2),",
    " (5), (7), (9), (12), (14), (21), (22), A102.2,",
    " A102.4; 304, 406, 408, 409, 415. LP: IFGC ref."});
END;

// reference page n (the Learn tile, and each tool's HELP)
learnPage(n)
BEGIN
  LOCAL h:={" No notes."};
  IF n==1 THEN h:={
    "SIZING GAS PIPING (ARKANSAS 402)",
    " 1 Load: add the input of every appliance at full",
    "   fire (402.2). Above 2,000 ft adjust for altitude.",
    " 2 CFH = Btu/h / heating value (Btu per ft³).",
    " 3 Length: longest length method (402.4.1): the run",
    "   from the meter to the farthest outlet, used for",
    "   every section. Arkansas DELETED the branch length",
    "   method; hybrid pressure (402.4.3) remains.",
    " 4 Use the table row equal to or longer than the",
    "   length, and the load of each section.",
    " 5 Pick the first size that carries the load.",
    " Arkansas tables: 402.4(2), (5), (7) steel; (9),",
    " (12), (14) copper; (21), (22) PE. Natural gas only.",
    " NA in a table = less than 10 CFH."}; END;
  IF n==2 THEN h:={
    "ARKANSAS TABLE NOTES",
    " Arkansas deleted the other IFGC tables, including",
    " CSST (size CSST by the maker's tables, 403.5.5)",
    " and propane (LP is under the Arkansas LP-Gas",
    " Board; the LP tables here are IFGC references).",
    " Table 402.4(21) PE stops at 2 in in Arkansas.",
    " Fittings: allow equivalent length when a run has",
    " 4 or more fittings (Appendix A, Table A102.2).",
    " Gas heavier than 0.70 SG: multiply capacity by",
    " the Table A102.4 factor (next higher SG).",
    " Inside buildings: 5 psig maximum (402.7).",
    " Copper: the gas supplier must approve it (403.5);",
    " not with over 0.3 grains H2S per 100 ft³.",
    " Copper tables use the Type K inside diameter."}; END;
  IF n==3 THEN h:={
    "COMBUSTION AIR (ARKANSAS 304)",
    " Indoor: 50 ft³ per 1,000 Btu/h (304.5.1). Known",
    " infiltration (304.5.2): 21 ft³/ACH (15 if fan-",
    " assisted) per 1,000 Btu/h, 0.60 ACH max; must be",
    " used under 0.40 ACH; a licensed mechanical",
    " engineer must verify it (Arkansas).",
    " Indoor openings: 1 in²/1,000 Btu/h each, 100 in²",
    " min, within 12 in of top and bottom; other story",
    " 2 in²/1,000 Btu/h.",
    " Outdoor, 2 openings: 1 in²/4,000 Btu/h each direct",
    " or vertical ducts; 1 in²/2,000 horizontal ducts.",
    " 1 opening (top): 1 in²/3,000 Btu/h, >= vent area.",
    " Arkansas: each outdoor opening 12 in² free area",
    " minimum, 3 in least dimension. Louvers unknown:",
    " wood 25%, metal 75%. Mechanical: 0.35 CFM/1,000."}; END;
  IF n==4 THEN h:={
    "PRESSURE TESTING (ARKANSAS 406)",
    " Test pressure: at least 1-1/2 times the maximum",
    " working pressure, and never under 3 psig.",
    " Duration: 1/2 hour for each 500 ft³ of pipe",
    " volume. 250 ft³ or less, or a single-family",
    " dwelling: 15 minutes minimum (Arkansas).",
    " Mechanical gauge: top of the scale no more than",
    " 5 times the test pressure.",
    " Isolate the pressure source before the test.",
    " New branches: leak-test the connection to the",
    " existing piping with leak fluid (406.1.3).",
    " Find leaks with a gas detector or leak fluid,",
    " never a flame. Test with air, nitrogen, CO2 or",
    " an inert gas, never oxygen (406.2)."}; END;
  IF n==5 THEN h:={
    "VALVES, TRAPS, SUPPORTS",
    " Shutoff valve: same room, within 6 ft of the",
    " appliance, upstream of the union or connector,",
    " with access (409.5.1).",
    " Sediment trap: a tee with a capped nipple down,",
    " after the shutoff and close to the inlet (408.4).",
    " Arkansas: not needed for lights, ranges, clothes",
    " dryers and outdoor grills.",
    "SUPPORTS (TABLE 415.1)",
    " Steel pipe: 1/2 in every 6 ft, 3/4 or 1 in every",
    " 8 ft, 1-1/4 in and up 10 ft (vertical: each floor)",
    " Tubing: 1/2 OD 4 ft, 5/8 or 3/4 OD 6 ft, 7/8 or",
    " 1 OD 8 ft (1 OD and up vertical: each floor).",
    " CSST: the maker's support spacing."}; END;
  IF n==6 THEN h:={
    "CLOCKING THE METER",
    "  CFH = ft³ per revolution x revs x 3600 / seconds",
    "  Btu/h = CFH x heating value (Btu per ft³)",
    "  Seconds for one rev = dial ft³ x 3600 x HV / input",
    " Turn every other appliance off first.",
    "MANIFOLD PRESSURE",
    " Gas flow through an orifice rises with the square",
    " root of the pressure:",
    "  new pressure = now x (rated / measured)²",
    " Typical: natural gas 3.5 in w.c., propane 10 in.",
    " Stay inside the plate's range; if you cannot,",
    " check the orifices and the heating value.",
    "ALTITUDE",
    " Usual rule: derate 4% for each 1,000 ft above",
    " sea level once above 2,000 ft. Follow the plate."}; END;
  IF n==7 THEN h:={
    "FLUE GAS ANALYSIS",
    "  Excess air % = O2 / (20.9 - O2) x 100",
    "  CO2 = CO2 max x (20.9 - O2) / 20.9",
    "  CO2 max: natural gas 11.7, propane 13.7,",
    "  #2 oil 15.4 %",
    "  CO air-free = CO x 20.9 / (20.9 - O2)",
    "  Net stack temp = flue temp - air temp",
    " Too little air: CO rises. Too much air: heat",
    " goes up the flue and efficiency drops.",
    " ANSI Z21.47 furnace limit: 400 ppm CO air-free.",
    " The efficiency shown is an estimate (Siegert",
    " formula); your analyzer may use its own."}; END;
  IF n==8 THEN h:={
    "OIL BURNERS",
    "  Firing rate GPH = input Btu/h / Btu per gallon",
    "  (#2 oil about 140,000 Btu per gallon)",
    " Nozzles are rated in GPH at 100 psi.",
    "  GPH at P = rated GPH x square root (P / 100)",
    " To fire a rate at a higher pump pressure, pick",
    " the nozzle rated  GPH / square root (P / 100).",
    " Also match the spray angle and pattern to the",
    " burner manufacturer's chart."}; END;
  IF n==9 THEN h:={
    "VENTING BASICS",
    " Category I: negative vent pressure, not",
    " condensing (natural draft, B-vent).",
    " Category II: negative pressure, condensing.",
    " Category III: positive pressure, not condensing.",
    " Category IV: positive pressure, condensing",
    " (PVC/CPVC per the manufacturer).",
    " Vent connectors slope up toward the vent at",
    " least 1/4 in per foot.",
    " Size vents with IFGC chapter 5 tables or the",
    " appliance instructions."}; END;
  IF n==10 THEN h:={
    "COPPER TUBE",
    " Type K (green) thickest wall, L (blue), M (red)",
    " thinnest; DWV yellow; ACR (blue) is sold by its",
    " outside diameter, the others by nominal size",
    " (OD = nominal + 1/8 in).",
    " ACR: soft (annealed) coils or hard (drawn).",
    " Fuel gas: Type K or L, or ACR (403.4.3).",
    "EXPANSION",
    " Copper grows 0.0000094 in per in per °F: 1.128",
    " in per 100 ft for a 100°F rise (CDA).",
    "  growth = coefficient x length x 12 x temp change"}; END;
  IF n==11 THEN h:={
    "BRAZING AND SOLDERING",
    " Brazing: the filler melts above 840°F; soldering",
    " below. Joints rely on capillary action.",
    " BCuP (copper-phosphorus): no flux copper to",
    " copper; use flux on brass, bronze or steel.",
    " BAg (silver) alloys: flux needed.",
    " Flow dry nitrogen through the tube while brazing",
    " refrigerant lines to stop oxide scale.",
    " Heat the tube first, then the fitting; feed the",
    " filler on the side away from the flame.",
    " Drinking water: lead-free solder only (50-50",
    " tin-lead is not allowed)."}; END;
  IF n==12 THEN h:={
    "PIPE OFFSETS",
    "  travel = offset x multiplier",
    "  run (advance) = offset x run factor",
    "  fitting    multiplier   run factor",
    "  11-1/4°     5.126        5.027",
    "  22-1/2°     2.613        2.414",
    "  30°         2.000        1.732",
    "  45°         1.414        1.000",
    "  60°         1.155        0.577",
    " Rolling offset: true offset = square root of",
    " (offset² + roll²), then use the same factors.",
    " Cut length = travel - take-off of both fittings."}; END;
  IF n==13 THEN h:={
    "FUELS AND UNITS",
    " 1 therm = 100,000 Btu (about 1 ccf of gas)",
    " Natural gas: about 1,000 Btu/ft³ (ask the utility)",
    " Propane: 2,516 Btu/ft³, 91,500 Btu/gal,",
    " 21,548 Btu/lb",
    " #2 fuel oil: about 140,000 Btu/gal",
    " 1 kWh = 3,412 Btu   1 ton = 12,000 Btu/h",
    " 1 hp = 2,544 Btu/h",
    " 1 psi = 27.7 in w.c. (code) = 16 oz/in²",
    " 1 in w.c. = 0.249 kPa = 2.49 mbar",
    " Fuel cost per million Btu delivered =",
    "  price / Btu in the unit x 1,000,000 / efficiency"}; END;
  IF n==14 THEN h:={
    "FURNACE OUTPUT AND AIRFLOW",
    "  output = input x efficiency",
    "  CFM = output / (1.08 x temperature rise)",
    "  temp rise = output / (1.08 x CFM)",
    " 1.08 = 60 min x 0.075 lb/ft³ x 0.24 Btu/lb°F",
    " Measure the rise between return and supply,",
    " out of sight of the heat exchanger, and keep it",
    " inside the range on the furnace plate."}; END;
  showText(gLearn(n),h);
END;

learnMenu()
BEGIN
  LOCAL t:=1;
  IF CHOOSE(t,"Learn",gLearn) THEN
    IF t>=1 THEN learnPage(t); END;
  END;
  gDown:=0;
END;

toolHelp(t)
BEGIN
  LOCAL pg:={1,2,2,1,6,6,6,3,7,14,8,4,13,13,10,5,12,10,11};
  learnPage(pg(t));
END;

// ================= tools =================

clearRows()
BEGIN
  gRL:={};
  gRV:={};
  gRN:={};
  gRC:={};
END;

addRow(l,v,n,c)
BEGIN
  LOCAL k:=SIZE(gRL)+1;
  gRL(k):=l;
  gRV(k):=v;
  gRN(k):=n;
  gRC(k):=c;
END;

calcSize()
BEGIN
  LOCAL t:=gV(1);
  LOCAL lf:=gV(2);
  LOCAL hv:=hvOf(gV(5),gTGas(gV(1)));
  LOCAL btu:=gV(3)*IFTE(gV(4)==1,hvOf(gV(5),gTGas(gV(1))),IFTE(gV(4)==2,1000,1));
  LOCAL m:=pipeTab(gV(1));
  LOCAL nm:=sizeSet(gTSz(gV(1)));
  LOCAL ls:=lenSet(gTLn(gV(1)));
  LOCAL r, ld, f, k, pick, nt;
  addRow("Table","402.4("+istr(gTNo(t))+")",IFTE(gTAR(t)==1,"AR: ","LP ref: ")+gTMat(t),IFTE(gTAR(t)==1,cText,cWarn));
  addRow("Gas",IFTE(gTGas(t)==1,"Natural","Propane"),"inlet "+gTIn(t)+", drop "+gTDrop(t),cText);
  r:=lenRow(t,lf);
  IF r==0 THEN
    addRow("Length","past the table","last row "+istr(ls(SIZE(ls)))+" ft",cBad);
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  addRow("Length row",istr(ls(r))+" ft",IFTE(ABS(ls(r)-lf)<0.001,"exact row","next longer than "+fmtTr(lf,1)+" ft"),cText);
  ld:=IFTE(gTUnit(t)==1,btu/hv,btu/1000);
  nt:="as entered";
  IF gV(4)<>IFTE(gTUnit(t)==1,1,2) THEN
    nt:=ithou(btu)+" Btu/h";
    IF gTUnit(t)==1 OR gV(4)==1 THEN nt:=nt+" at "+ithou(hv)+"/ft³"; END;
  END;
  addRow("Load",fmtTr(ld,1)+" "+unitName(t),nt,cText);
  f:=1;
  IF gTGas(t)==1 THEN f:=sgMul(gV(6)); END;
  IF f<>1 THEN addRow("SG factor","x "+fmtN(f,2),"Table A102.4, SG "+fmtN(gV(6),2),cWarn); END;
  pick:=0;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(nm) DO
    IF pick==0 AND m(r,k)>0 AND m(r,k)*f>=ld-0.0001 THEN pick:=k; END;
  END;
  IF pick==0 THEN
    addRow("Size","none big enough","largest carries "+capTxt(m(r,SIZE(nm))*f),cBad);
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  addRow("Size",nm(pick),"carries "+capTxt(m(r,pick)*f)+" "+unitName(t),cSelc);
  IF pick>1 THEN addRow("One smaller",nm(pick-1),"only "+capTxt(m(r,pick-1)*f),cDim); END;
  IF DIM(gTUse(t))>0 THEN addRow("Use for","",gTUse(t),cDim); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcCap()
BEGIN
  LOCAL t:=gV(7);
  LOCAL m:=pipeTab(gV(7));
  LOCAL nm:=sizeSet(gTSz(gV(7)));
  LOCAL ls:=lenSet(gTLn(gV(7)));
  LOCAL r:=lenRow(gV(7),gV(8));
  LOCAL k;
  addRow("402.4("+istr(gTNo(t))+")",IFTE(gTAR(t)==1,"Arkansas","LP ref."),IFTE(gTGas(t)==1,"NG","LP")+" inlet "+gTIn(t)+", drop "+gTDrop(t),IFTE(gTAR(t)==1,cText,cWarn));
  IF r==0 THEN
    addRow("Length","past the table","last row "+istr(ls(SIZE(ls)))+" ft",cBad);
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  addRow("Row "+istr(ls(r))+" ft",unitName(t),gTMat(t),cSelc);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(nm) STEP 2 DO
    IF k<SIZE(nm) THEN
      addRow(nm(k),capTxt(m(r,k)),nm(k+1)+":  "+capTxt(m(r,k+1)),cText);
    ELSE
      addRow(nm(k),capTxt(m(r,k)),"",cText);
    END;
  END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcFit()
BEGIN
  LOCAL k:=gV(9)-3;
  LOCAL nm:=choiceList(4);
  LOCAL e1, e2, e3, e4, eq;
  IF k<1 THEN
    addRow("Size",nm(gV(9)),"not in Table A102.2",cWarn);
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  e1:=gV(11)*gFit(k,2);
  e2:=gV(12)*gFit(k,1);
  e3:=gV(13)*gFit(k,4);
  e4:=gV(14)*gFit(k,5);
  eq:=e1+e2+e3+e4;
  addRow("90° ells",fmtN(e1,2)+" ft",istr(gV(11))+" x "+fmtTr(gFit(k,2),2)+" ft",cText);
  addRow("45° ells",fmtN(e2,2)+" ft",istr(gV(12))+" x "+fmtTr(gFit(k,1),2)+" ft",cText);
  addRow("Tees",fmtN(e3,2)+" ft",istr(gV(13))+" x "+fmtTr(gFit(k,4),2)+" ft",cText);
  addRow("Gate valves",fmtN(e4,2)+" ft",istr(gV(14))+" x "+fmtTr(gFit(k,5),2)+" ft",cText);
  addRow("Fittings",fmtN(eq,2)+" ft","equivalent pipe, Table A102.2",cText);
  addRow("Total length",fmtTr(gV(10)+eq,1)+" ft","pipe + fittings: size with this",cSelc);
  addRow("CSST","","AR: size by the maker's tables (403.5.5)",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcLoad()
BEGIN
  LOCAL tot:=gV(15)+gV(16)+gV(17)+gV(18)+gV(19)+gV(20);
  LOCAL g:=gV(21);
  LOCAL hv:=hvOf(gV(22),gV(21));
  LOCAL n:=(gV(15)>0)+(gV(16)>0)+(gV(17)>0)+(gV(18)>0)+(gV(19)>0)+(gV(20)>0);
  addRow("Total load",ithou(tot)+" Btu/h",istr(n)+" appliances at full input",cSelc);
  addRow("In kBtu/h",fmtTr(tot/1000,2),"= MBH; propane tables use this",cText);
  addRow("Gas flow",fmtTr(tot/hv,1)+" CFH","at "+ithou(hv)+" Btu/ft³",cSelc);
  IF g==1 THEN
    addRow("Therms/h",fmtTr(tot/100000,3),"100,000 Btu per therm",cText);
  ELSE
    addRow("Gallons/h",fmtTr(tot/91500,3),"91,500 Btu per LP gallon",cText);
    addRow("Pounds/h",fmtTr(tot/21548,3),"21,548 Btu per LP pound",cText);
  END;
  addRow("Code","","402.2: size for all running at once",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcClock()
BEGIN
  LOCAL cfh:=gV(23)*gV(24)*3600/gV(25);
  LOCAL bt:=gV(23)*gV(24)*3600/gV(25)*gV(26);
  LOCAL rt:=gV(27);
  LOCAL pc;
  addRow("Gas flow",fmtTr(cfh,2)+" CFH",fmtTr(gV(23)*gV(24),2)+" ft³ in "+fmtTr(gV(25),1)+" s",cText);
  addRow("Input",ithou(bt)+" Btu/h","CFH x "+ithou(gV(26))+" Btu/ft³",cSelc);
  IF rt>0 THEN
    pc:=100*bt/rt;
    addRow("Of rated",fmtN(pc,1)+"%","plate "+ithou(rt)+" Btu/h",IFTE(ABS(pc-100)<=2,cGood,cWarn));
    addRow("Target time",fmtN(gV(23)*3600*gV(26)/rt,1)+" s","per revolution at the rated input",cText);
    addRow("Rated flow",fmtTr(rt/gV(26),1)+" CFH","plate input / heating value",cText);
    addRow("Verdict",IFTE(pc>102,"overfired",IFTE(pc<98,"underfired","on rate")),"within ±2% is close",IFTE(ABS(pc-100)<=2,cGood,cWarn));
  END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcMan()
BEGIN
  LOCAL r:=gV(29)/gV(28);
  LOCAL np:=gV(30)*r*r;
  LOCAL lp:=gV(31)==2;
  addRow("Firing",fmtN(100*gV(28)/gV(29),1)+"%","of the rated input",IFTE(ABS(gV(28)/gV(29)-1)<=0.02,cGood,cWarn));
  addRow("Set to",fmtN(np,2)+" in w.c.","now "+fmtTr(gV(30),2)+" x (rated / measured)²",cSelc);
  addRow("Change",IFTE(np>=gV(30),"+","")+fmtN(np-gV(30),2)+" in w.c.","",cText);
  addRow("Typical",IFTE(lp,"10 in w.c.","3.5 in w.c."),IFTE(lp,"propane manifold","natural gas manifold"),cDim);
  addRow("Limit","","stay in the plate's range; else orifices",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcAlt()
BEGIN
  LOCAL el:=gV(33);
  LOCAL pc:=IFTE(gV(33)>gV(35),gV(34)*gV(33)/1000,0);
  addRow("Derate",fmtN(pc,1)+"%",IFTE(pc>0,fmtTr(gV(34),1)+"% x "+fmtTr(el/1000,2)+" thousand ft","not above "+ithou(gV(35))+" ft"),cSelc);
  addRow("Derated input",ithou(gV(32)*(1-pc/100))+" Btu/h","from "+ithou(gV(32))+" Btu/h",cSelc);
  addRow("Reduction",ithou(gV(32)*pc/100)+" Btu/h","",cText);
  addRow("Air pressure",fmtN(14.696*(1-0.0000068754*el)^5.2559,2)+" psia","standard atmosphere",cText);
  addRow("Code","","402.2: adjust loads above 2,000 ft",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcAir()
BEGIN
  LOCAL inp:=gV(36);
  LOCAL fan:=MIN(gV(37),gV(36));
  LOCAL vol:=gV(38)*gV(39)*gV(40);
  LOCAL ach:=gV(41);
  LOCAL fr:=IFTE(gV(42)==2,0.75,IFTE(gV(42)==3,0.25,1));
  LOCAL req, ia, nt, rf, ov, oh, o1;
  IF ach>0 THEN
    req:=21/ach*(inp-fan)/1000+15/ach*fan/1000;
    nt:="304.5.2: an engineer must verify";
  ELSE
    req:=50*inp/1000;
    nt:="304.5.1: 50 ft³ per 1,000 Btu/h";
  END;
  addRow("Needed",fmtTr(req,0)+" ft³",nt,cText);
  addRow("Room",fmtTr(vol,0)+" ft³",IFTE(vol>=req,"indoor air is enough","too small: add openings"),IFTE(vol>=req,cGood,cWarn));
  ia:=MAX(100,inp/1000);
  addRow("Indoor opngs",fmtTr(ia,1)+" in²","each of 2"+IFTE(fr<1,", louver "+fmtTr(ia/fr,1),", 100 in² min"),cText);
  // Arkansas 304.6: each outdoor opening at least 12 in² free area
  ov:=MAX(12,inp/4000);
  oh:=MAX(12,inp/2000);
  o1:=MAX(12,inp/3000);
  addRow("Out direct",fmtTr(ov,1)+" in²","each of 2"+IFTE(fr<1,", louver "+fmtTr(ov/fr,1),", or vertical ducts"),cText);
  addRow("Out horiz.",fmtTr(oh,1)+" in²","each of 2"+IFTE(fr<1,", louver "+fmtTr(oh/fr,1),", horizontal ducts"),cText);
  addRow("One opening",fmtTr(o1,1)+" in²",IFTE(fr<1,"louver "+fmtTr(o1/fr,1)+", ","")+"and >= vent connectors",cText);
  IF vol<req AND vol>0 THEN
    rf:=1-vol/req;
    addRow("Combination",fmtN(rf,2)+" x","outdoor sizes x this (304.7)",cText);
  END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcFlue()
BEGIN
  LOCAL o2:=gV(44);
  LOCAL cmax:=IFTE(gV(43)==1,11.7,IFTE(gV(43)==2,13.7,15.4));
  LOCAL a2:=IFTE(gV(43)==1,0.66,IFTE(gV(43)==2,0.63,0.68));
  LOCAL b:=IFTE(gV(43)==1,0.009,IFTE(gV(43)==2,0.008,0.007));
  LOCAL nst:=gV(46)-gV(47);
  LOCAL caf, loss;
  caf:=gV(45)*20.9/(20.9-o2);
  loss:=nst/1.8*(a2/(21-o2)+b);
  addRow("CO2",fmtN(cmax*(20.9-o2)/20.9,1)+"%","max "+fmtN(cmax,1)+"% at 0% O2",cText);
  addRow("Excess air",fmtN(100*o2/(20.9-o2),0)+"%","O2 / (20.9 - O2)",cText);
  addRow("CO air-free",istr(caf)+" ppm","CO x 20.9 / (20.9 - O2)",IFTE(caf>400,cBad,IFTE(caf>100,cWarn,cGood)));
  addRow("Net stack",fmtTr(nst,0)+"°F","flue - combustion air",cText);
  addRow("Efficiency",fmtN(100-loss,1)+"%","estimate, Siegert formula",cDim);
  addRow("CO limit","400 ppm","air-free, ANSI Z21.47 furnaces",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcFurn()
BEGIN
  LOCAL op:=gV(48)*gV(49)/100;
  LOCAL rs:=gV(50);
  LOCAL cf:=gV(51);
  addRow("Output",ithou(op)+" Btu/h",fmtTr(gV(49),1)+"% of "+ithou(gV(48)),cSelc);
  addRow("Lost",ithou(gV(48)-op)+" Btu/h","input - output",cText);
  IF rs>0 THEN
    addRow("Airflow",istr(op/(1.08*rs))+" CFM","output / (1.08 x "+fmtTr(rs,1)+"°F)",cSelc);
  ELSE
    IF cf>0 THEN
      addRow("Temp rise",fmtN(op/(1.08*cf),1)+"°F","output / (1.08 x "+istr(cf)+" CFM)",cSelc);
    ELSE
      addRow("Enter","temp rise or CFM","to work out the other",cWarn);
    END;
  END;
  addRow("In kW",fmtN(op/3412.14,2)+" kW","output",cText);
  addRow("Check","","rise inside the plate's range",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcOil()
BEGIN
  LOCAL hv:=gV(55);
  LOCAL gph:=gV(52)/gV(55);
  LOCAL q:=sqroot(gV(54)/100);
  LOCAL ng:=gV(53)*sqroot(gV(54)/100);
  addRow("Firing rate",fmtN(gph,2)+" GPH","input / "+ithou(hv)+" Btu/gal",cSelc);
  addRow("Nozzle",fmtN(gph/q,2)+" GPH","rated at 100 psi, to fire that",cSelc);
  addRow("Your nozzle",fmtN(ng,3)+" GPH",fmtTr(gV(53),2)+" GPH at "+istr(gV(54))+" psi",cText);
  addRow("Its input",ithou(ng*hv)+" Btu/h","GPH x "+ithou(hv),cText);
  addRow("Rule","","flow x square root (psi / 100)",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcTest()
BEGIN
  LOCAL wp:=gV(56);
  LOCAL tp:=MAX(1.5*gV(56),3);
  LOCAL st:=choiceList(4);
  LOCAL v1:=gStID(gV(58))^2*0.7853981634/144*gV(59);
  LOCAL v2:=gStID(gV(60))^2*0.7853981634/144*gV(61);
  LOCAL vol, mins;
  vol:=v1+v2;
  // Arkansas 406.4.2: 15 minutes for 250 ft³ or less or a single-family
  // dwelling, otherwise 1/2 hour for each 500 ft³
  IF vol<=250 OR gV(57)==2 THEN
    mins:=15;
  ELSE
    mins:=-FLOOR(-30*vol/500+0.0001);
  END;
  addRow("Test pressure",fmtTr(tp,2)+" psig",IFTE(1.5*wp>3,"1-1/2 x working","3 psig minimum"),cSelc);
  addRow("Pipe volume",fmtN(vol,2)+" ft³",fmtN(v1,2)+" + "+fmtN(v2,2)+" (Sch 40 ID)",cText);
  addRow("Duration",istr(mins)+" min",IFTE(vol<=250 OR gV(57)==2,IFTE(gV(57)==2,"single-family: 15 min","250 ft³ or less: 15 min"),"30 min per 500 ft³; IFGC rounds up: "+istr(-30*FLOOR(-vol/500+0.000001))),cSelc);
  addRow("Gauge",fmtTr(5*tp,1)+" psi max","scale top: 5 x test pressure",cText);
  addRow("Code","","AR Fuel Gas Code 406.4.1, 406.4.2",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcCost()
BEGIN
  LOCAL c1:=gV(62)*10/(gV(63)/100);
  LOCAL c2:=gV(64)/0.0915/(gV(65)/100);
  LOCAL c3:=gV(66)/0.14/(gV(67)/100);
  LOCAL c4:=gV(68)*1000000/3412.14/gV(69);
  LOCAL nm:={"Natural gas","Propane","Fuel oil","Electric"};
  LOCAL cs:={c1,c2,c3,c4};
  LOCAL k;
  LOCAL best:=1;
  FOR k FROM 2 TO 4 DO
    IF cs(k)<cs(best) THEN best:=k; END;
  END;
  addRow("Natural gas","$"+fmtN(c1,2),"per million Btu delivered",IFTE(best==1,cGood,cText));
  addRow("Propane","$"+fmtN(c2,2),"91,500 Btu per gallon",IFTE(best==2,cGood,cText));
  addRow("Fuel oil","$"+fmtN(c3,2),"140,000 Btu per gallon",IFTE(best==3,cGood,cText));
  addRow("Electric","$"+fmtN(c4,2),"3,412 Btu per kWh, COP "+fmtTr(gV(69),1),IFTE(best==4,cGood,cText));
  addRow("Cheapest",nm(best),"per unit of heat delivered",cSelc);
  RETURN 1;
END;

convFactor(k)
BEGIN
  IF k==1 THEN RETURN {1/27.7,1,1/16,0.491154,0.1450377,0.01450377,12/27.7}; END;
  IF k==2 THEN RETURN {1,100000,3412.14,1000,100000,91500,21548,140000}; END;
  RETURN {1,1000,3412.14,12000,2544.43,1000,91500};
END;

calcConv()
BEGIN
  LOCAL ct:=gV(70);
  LOCAL u:=convUnits(gV(70));
  LOCAL f:=convFactor(gV(70));
  LOCAL fr:=MAX(1,MIN(SIZE(convUnits(gV(70))),gV(72)));
  LOCAL bv, k;
  bv:=gV(71)*f(fr);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(u) DO
    addRow(u(k),fmtE(bv/f(k)),IFTE(k==fr,"entered",""),IFTE(k==fr,cSelc,cText));
  END;
  IF ct>=2 THEN addRow("Basis","","gas 1,000 Btu/ft³; LP, oil per Learn",cDim); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcCu()
BEGIN
  LOCAL ty:=gV(73);
  LOCAL ac:=gV(73)>=4;
  LOCAL k:=IFTE(gV(73)>=4,gV(75),gV(74));
  LOCAL nm:=IFTE(gV(73)>=4,choiceList(12),choiceList(11));
  LOCAL tn:=choiceList(10);
  LOCAL clr:={"green","blue","red","blue","blue"};
  LOCAL m, od, di, w, lb, gl;
  IF ty==1 THEN m:=gCuK; END;
  IF ty==2 THEN m:=gCuL; END;
  IF ty==3 THEN m:=gCuM; END;
  IF ty==4 THEN m:=gAcrA; END;
  IF ty==5 THEN m:=gAcrD; END;
  od:=m(k,1);
  IF od<=0 THEN
    addRow("Size",nm(k),"not made in "+tn(ty),cWarn);
    RETURN 0;
  END;
  di:=m(k,2);
  w:=m(k,3);
  lb:=m(k,4);
  gl:=di*di*0.7853981634/144*7.48051948;
  addRow(tn(ty),nm(k),"marking color: "+clr(ty),cText);
  addRow("Outside",fmtN(od,3)+" in",fmtIn(od),cText);
  addRow("Inside",fmtN(di,3)+" in","wall "+fmtN(w,3)+" in",cSelc);
  addRow("Weight",fmtN(lb,3)+" lb/ft",fmtTr(lb*gV(76),1)+" lb in "+istr(gV(76))+" ft",cText);
  addRow("Holds",fmtN(gl,4)+" gal/ft",fmtTr(gl*gV(76),2)+" gal in "+istr(gV(76))+" ft",cText);
  addRow("Fuel gas",IFTE(ty==3,"not allowed","K, L, ACR"),"AR 403.5: gas supplier must OK",IFTE(ty==3,cWarn,cText));
  addRow("Support","",tubeSup(od)+" (Table 415.1)",cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcSteel()
BEGIN
  LOCAL k:=gV(77);
  LOCAL nm:=choiceList(4);
  LOCAL od:=gStOD(gV(77));
  LOCAL di:=gStID(gV(77));
  LOCAL w:=(gStOD(gV(77))-gStID(gV(77)))/2;
  LOCAL lb, cf;
  lb:=10.69*(od-w)*w;
  cf:=di*di*0.7853981634/144;
  addRow(nm(k),"Schedule 40",IFTE(k<=16,"= standard weight","heavier than std weight"),cText);
  addRow("Outside",fmtN(od,3)+" in",fmtIn(od),cText);
  addRow("Inside",fmtN(di,3)+" in","wall "+fmtN(w,3)+" in",cSelc);
  addRow("Weight",fmtN(lb,2)+" lb/ft",fmtTr(lb*gV(78),0)+" lb in "+istr(gV(78))+" ft",cText);
  addRow("Volume",fmtN(cf*100,3)+" ft³","per 100 ft ("+fmtN(cf*748.051948,2)+" gal)",cText);
  addRow("In "+istr(gV(78))+" ft",fmtN(cf*gV(78),3)+" ft³","for test duration",cText);
  addRow("Threads",fmtTr(gStTPI(k),1)+" per in","NPT",cText);
  addRow("Support",IFTE(gStSup(k)>0,"every "+istr(gStSup(k))+" ft","not listed"),"horizontal, Table 415.1",cText);
  IF k>=4 THEN addRow("90° ell","= "+fmtTr(gFit(k-3,2),2)+" ft","of pipe (Table A102.2)",cDim); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcOff()
BEGIN
  LOCAL a:=gV(81);
  LOCAL mu:={5.125830895,2.61312593,2,1.414213562,1.154700538};
  LOCAL cot:={5.027339492,2.414213562,1.732050808,1,0.577350269};
  LOCAL nm:=choiceList(13);
  LOCAL tf:=sqroot(gV(79)^2+gV(80)^2);
  LOCAL tr, rn;
  tr:=tf*mu(a);
  rn:=tf*cot(a);
  IF gV(80)>0 THEN addRow("True offset",fmtIn(tf),fmtN(tf,3)+" in, rolling",cText); END;
  addRow("Multiplier",fmtN(mu(a),3),nm(a)+" fittings",cText);
  addRow("Travel",fmtIn(tr),fmtN(tr,3)+" in center to center",cSelc);
  addRow("Run",fmtIn(rn),fmtN(rn,3)+" in along the pipe",cText);
  IF gV(82)>0 THEN addRow("Cut length",fmtIn(tr-2*gV(82)),"travel - 2 take-offs",cSelc); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcExp()
BEGIN
  LOCAL c:=IFTE(gV(83)==6,gV(86),gExp(gV(83)));
  LOCAL nm:=choiceList(14);
  LOCAL dl:=IFTE(gV(83)==6,gV(86),gExp(gV(83)))/1000000*gV(84)*12*gV(85);
  addRow("Coefficient",fmtTr(c,2),"millionths in/in/°F, "+nm(gV(83)),cText);
  addRow("Expansion",fmtIn(dl),fmtN(dl,3)+" in",cSelc);
  addRow("Per 100 ft",fmtN(c/1000000*1200*100,3)+" in","for 100°F change",cText);
  addRow("Formula","","coef x ft x 12 x °F",cDim);
  IF gV(83)==1 THEN addRow("Source","","CDA: 0.0000094 in/in/°F",cDim); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

calcBraze()
BEGIN
  LOCAL k:=gV(87);
  LOCAL nm:=choiceList(15);
  LOCAL bz:=gBzLiq(gV(87))>840;
  addRow(nm(k),IFTE(bz,"brazing alloy","solder"),IFTE(bz,"melts above 840°F","melts below 840°F"),cSelc);
  addRow("Silver",gBzAg(k)+" %","",cText);
  addRow("Phosphorus",gBzP(k)+" %","",cText);
  IF DIM(gBzX(k))>0 THEN addRow("Also",gBzX(k)+" %","copper or the rest",cText); END;
  addRow("Solidus",istr(gBzSol(k))+"°F","starts to melt",cText);
  addRow("Liquidus",istr(gBzLiq(k))+"°F","fully liquid",cText);
  addRow("Range",istr(gBzLiq(k)-gBzSol(k))+"°F","wide range fills gaps",cText);
  addRow("Note","",gBzN(k),cDim);
  RETURN 1;
END;

toolCalc(t)
BEGIN
  clearRows();
  IF t==1 THEN calcSize(); END;
  IF t==2 THEN calcCap(); END;
  IF t==3 THEN calcFit(); END;
  IF t==4 THEN calcLoad(); END;
  IF t==5 THEN calcClock(); END;
  IF t==6 THEN calcMan(); END;
  IF t==7 THEN calcAlt(); END;
  IF t==8 THEN calcAir(); END;
  IF t==9 THEN calcFlue(); END;
  IF t==10 THEN calcFurn(); END;
  IF t==11 THEN calcOil(); END;
  IF t==12 THEN calcTest(); END;
  IF t==13 THEN calcCost(); END;
  IF t==14 THEN calcConv(); END;
  IF t==15 THEN calcCu(); END;
  IF t==16 THEN calcSteel(); END;
  IF t==17 THEN calcOff(); END;
  IF t==18 THEN calcExp(); END;
  IF t==19 THEN calcBraze(); END;
END;

// ================= screens =================

drawHome()
BEGIN
  LOCAL k, x, y, c, l1, l2;
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,239,cBg);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,20,cPanel);
  TEXTOUT_P("HVAC GAS",G1,6,3,3,cText);
  rtext("gas and piping",218,6,1,cDim);
  chip("HELP",224);
  chip("EXIT",272);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO 20 DO
    x:=((k-1) MOD 4)*80;
    y:=23+IP((k-1)/4)*43;
    IF k<=gNT THEN
      c:=gTCat(k);
      l1:=gTile1(k);
      l2:=gTile2(k);
    ELSE
      c:=6;
      l1:="Learn";
      l2:="notes";
    END;
    RECT_P(G1,x+2,y,x+77,y+40,gCatC(c));
    RECT_P(G1,x+2,y,x+77,y+2,gCatL(c));
    IF l2=="" THEN
      ctext(l1,x+40,y+14,2,cWhite);
    ELSE
      ctext(l1,x+40,y+7,2,cWhite);
      ctext(l2,x+40,y+22,2,cWhite);
    END;
    IF k==gHome THEN box2(x,y-2,x+79,y+42,cSelc); END;
  END;
  BLIT_P(G0,G1);
END;

drawTool()
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  LOCAL n:=SIZE(sl);
  LOCAL k, s, x0, y, txt, big, fv;
  toolCalc(gTool);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,239,cBg);
  RECT_P(G1,0,0,319,20,gCatC(gTCat(gTool)));
  TEXTOUT_P(gTName(gTool),G1,5,3,3,cWhite);
  chip("HELP",272);
  // input boxes, two per row
  FOR k FROM 1 TO n DO
    s:=sl(k);
    x0:=((k-1) MOD 2)*160;
    y:=24+IP((k-1)/2)*20;
    TEXTOUT_P(slotName(s),G1,x0+4,y+4,1,cDim);
    IF k==gTSel AND gEnt THEN
      RECT_P(G1,x0+74,y,x0+157,y+17,cSelc,cHit);
      txt:=entText()+"_";
    ELSE
      RECT_P(G1,x0+74,y,x0+157,y+17,IFTE(k==gTSel,cSelc,cEdge),cPanel);
      txt:=slotText(s);
    END;
    big:=DIM(txt)<=11;
    TEXTOUT_P(txt,G1,x0+78,y+IFTE(big,2,4),IFTE(big,2,1),cText);
  END;
  // results
  y:=24+IP((n+1)/2)*20+3;
  LINE_P(G1,0,y-2,319,y-2,cEdge);
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(gRL) DO
    IF (k MOD 2)==0 THEN RECT_P(G1,0,y,319,y+14,cRow); END;
    TEXTOUT_P(gRL(k),G1,5,y+2,1,cDim);
    // a long value and note together: the value in the small font
    fv:=2;
    IF textw(gRV(k),2)+textw(gRN(k),1)>220 THEN fv:=1; END;
    TEXTOUT_P(gRV(k),G1,90,y+IFTE(fv==2,1,2),fv,gRC(k));
    rtext(gRN(k),316,y+2,1,cDim);
    y:=y+15;
  END;
  drawMenu({"EDIT","RESET","< PREV","NEXT >","HOME"});
  BLIT_P(G0,G1);
END;

openTool(t)
BEGIN
  gTool:=t;
  gTSel:=1;
  gEnt:=0;
  gScr:=2;
END;

goHome()
BEGIN
  gHome:=gTool;
  gEnt:=0;
  gScr:=1;
END;

toolsMenu()
BEGIN
  LOCAL t:=gTool;
  IF CHOOSE(t,"Tools",gTName) THEN
    IF t>=1 THEN openTool(t); END;
  END;
  gDown:=0;
END;

// RESET: the tool's example values
resetTool()
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  LOCAL k;
  FOR k FROM 1 TO SIZE(sl) DO
    gV(sl(k)):=gDef(sl(k));
  END;
  gEnt:=0;
END;

// open tile k: a tool, or the Learn pages
openTile(k)
BEGIN
  gHome:=k;
  IF k>gNT THEN
    learnMenu();
  ELSE
    openTool(k);
  END;
END;

// ================= input handling =================

// returns 0 to quit
onHome(ev)
BEGIN
  LOCAL mx, my, k;
  IF TYPE(ev)==6 THEN
    IF ev(1)==0 THEN gDown:=1; END;
    IF ev(1)<>3 OR gDown==0 OR SIZE(ev)<3 THEN RETURN 1; END;
    gDown:=0;
    mx:=ev(2);
    my:=ev(3);
    IF my<21 THEN
      IF mx>=272 THEN RETURN 0; END;
      IF mx>=224 THEN showHelp(); END;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    k:=IP((my-23)/43)*4+MIN(3,IP(mx/80))+1;
    IF my>=23 AND k>=1 AND k<=20 THEN openTile(k); END;
    RETURN 1;
  END;
  IF ev==7 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome==1,20,gHome-1); END;
  IF ev==8 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome==20,1,gHome+1); END;
  IF ev==2 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome<=4,gHome+16,gHome-4); END;
  IF ev==12 THEN gHome:=IFTE(gHome>16,gHome-16,gHome+4); END;
  IF ev==30 THEN openTile(gHome); END;
  IF ev==3 THEN showHelp(); END;
  IF ev==13 THEN toolsMenu(); END;
  IF ev==4 THEN RETURN 0; END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

onTool(ev)
BEGIN
  LOCAL sl:=toolIns(gTool);
  LOCAL n:=SIZE(sl);
  LOCAL k, mx, my, rw, idx, dg;
  IF gTSel>n THEN gTSel:=1; END;
  IF TYPE(ev)==6 THEN
    IF ev(1)==0 THEN gDown:=1; END;
    IF ev(1)<>3 OR gDown==0 OR SIZE(ev)<3 THEN RETURN 1; END;
    gDown:=0;
    mx:=ev(2);
    my:=ev(3);
    commitEnt();
    IF my>=220 THEN
      k:=IP(mx/64)+1;
      IF k==1 THEN editSlot(sl(gTSel)); END;
      IF k==2 THEN resetTool(); END;
      IF k==3 THEN openTool(IFTE(gTool==1,gNT,gTool-1)); END;
      IF k==4 THEN openTool(IFTE(gTool==gNT,1,gTool+1)); END;
      IF k==5 THEN goHome(); END;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    IF my<21 THEN
      IF mx>=272 THEN toolHelp(gTool); END;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    // tap an input box to change it
    rw:=IP((my-24)/20);
    idx:=rw*2+IP(mx/160)+1;
    IF my>=24 AND rw<IP((n+1)/2) AND idx<=n THEN
      gTSel:=idx;
      editSlot(sl(idx));
    END;
    RETURN 1;
  END;
  // digits and the decimal point type straight into a number box
  dg:=keyDigit(ev);
  IF dg>=0 THEN
    IF gSC(sl(gTSel))==0 THEN typeKey(dg); END;
    RETURN 1;
  END;
  IF gEnt THEN
    IF ev==45 OR ev==27 THEN
      gENeg:=1-gENeg;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    IF ev==19 THEN
      backKey();
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    IF ev==4 THEN
      gEnt:=0;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
    // any other key keeps the typed number first
    commitEnt();
    IF ev==30 THEN RETURN 1; END;
  ELSE
    IF (ev==45 OR ev==27) AND gSC(sl(gTSel))==0 THEN
      gEnt:=1;
      gEK:={};
      gENeg:=1;
      RETURN 1;
    END;
  END;
  IF ev==7 THEN gTSel:=IFTE(gTSel==1,n,gTSel-1); END;
  IF ev==8 THEN gTSel:=IFTE(gTSel==n,1,gTSel+1); END;
  IF ev==2 THEN bumpSlot(sl(gTSel),1); END;
  IF ev==12 THEN bumpSlot(sl(gTSel),-1); END;
  IF ev==30 THEN editSlot(sl(gTSel)); END;
  IF ev==3 THEN toolHelp(gTool); END;
  IF ev==13 THEN toolsMenu(); END;
  IF ev==4 THEN goHome(); END;
  RETURN 1;
END;

// ================= main =================

EXPORT HVACGAS()
BEGIN
  LOCAL run:=1;
  LOCAL ev;
  DIMGROB_P(G1,320,240);
  DIMGROB_P(G9,320,30);
  gEnt:=0;
  WHILE run DO
    IF gScr==1 THEN drawHome(); ELSE drawTool(); END;
    ev:=WAIT(-1);   // key code, touch event list, or -1 after a 1 minute timeout
    IF gScr==1 THEN run:=onHome(ev); ELSE run:=onTool(ev); END;
  END;
END;
